# Meadow Prints & Embroidery

> Meadow Prints & Embroidery LLC is a custom apparel shop in Monmouth County, New Jersey. It screen prints, embroiders and direct-to-garment prints t-shirts, polos, hoodies, jackets, hats, bags and workwear for businesses, teams, schools and events. There is no walk-in storefront; customers order by phone, email or the website and receive a free digital proof before anything is produced.

## Key facts

- Location: based in Monmouth County, New Jersey; serves New Jersey, New York City, Westchester, Long Island and Connecticut
- Phone: (732) 763-6078
- Email: meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday 8am-7pm, Saturday 10am-4pm, closed Sunday (Eastern Time)
- Founded: 2024 by Roger Padalec, Founder & Head of Operations
- Pricing: quoted per order; there are no list prices on the site
- Proof: free digital proof within 24 hours; nothing is printed or stitched until the customer approves it
- Turnaround: about two weeks after proof approval; rush production in as few as 3 days
- Minimums: none on many products; screen printing is most cost-effective at 12 pieces or more
- Artwork: customers email their logo or design to meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com; art review and embroidery digitizing are free
- Catalog: 2,105 blank styles, none sold undecorated

## Services

- [Custom embroidery](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/embroidery): stitched logos on polos, hats, jackets and bags
- [Screen printing](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/screen-printing): bold, durable prints for orders of 12 or more
- [Custom t-shirts](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/custom-t-shirts): tees for teams, events, businesses and families
- [Who we work with](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/use-cases): businesses, schools and clubs, events, families, sports teams

# Full details

Below is the main content of the site's key pages, for AI assistants that want the complete picture.

## Services

### [Custom t-shirts in Monmouth County, NJ](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/custom-t-shirts)

Need shirts for a team, a staff, a fundraiser or a family reunion? We make custom t-shirts for groups all over Monmouth County - one shirt or five hundred - and help you pick the right blank and print method for your budget.

**What is the minimum order for custom t-shirts?**
Many products have no minimum. Screen printing is best at 12 pieces and up; smaller orders are usually done with direct-to-garment printing.

**How long do custom t-shirts take?**
About two weeks after you approve your proof. Rush production is available in as few as 3 days.

**Can you help with my design?**
Yes. Every order includes a free art review, and we can create a mockup from a rough idea or an existing logo.

**Where are you located?**
Meadow Prints & Embroidery is based in Monmouth County, New Jersey, and serves the tri-state area. See our service areas.

### [Screen printing in Monmouth County, NJ](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/screen-printing)

Screen printing is the classic way to put a bold, long-lasting design on a shirt. We print tees, hoodies, tanks and team gear for Monmouth County businesses, schools, leagues and events, and the more you order the less each piece costs.

**How many shirts do I need to order for screen printing?**
Screen printing is most cost-effective at 12 pieces and up. For smaller quantities we will usually recommend direct-to-garment printing or embroidery instead.

**How much does screen printing cost?**
It depends on the garment, the number of ink colors and the quantity - the more you order, the lower the price per piece. Request a free quote and we will price your exact project.

**Can you screen print on hoodies and other garments?**
Yes. We print tees, long sleeves, tanks, hoodies, crewneck sweatshirts and many bags and performance fabrics.

**Do you serve my town?**
We're based in Monmouth County, NJ and serve New Jersey, New York City and the tri-state area. See our service areas.

### [Custom embroidery with a premium finish.](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/embroidery)

Stitched logos add instant polish to polos, caps, jackets, and bags for Monmouth County businesses, teams, and crews. Free digitizing, precise color matching, and a look that lasts for years.

### [Bulk custom t-shirts](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/bulk-t-shirts)

Need 50, 200 or 1,000 shirts? We screen print bulk t-shirt orders for companies, contractors, schools and events across Monmouth County, with volume pricing, a free proof in 24 hours and the option to split delivery between locations.

**How many shirts count as a bulk order?**
There's no magic number - pricing improves as the quantity grows, and screen printing is the most cost-effective method from about 12 shirts up. Crew and company orders of 50, 100 or several hundred shirts get the best per-shirt price.

**What's the best shirt for a large order?**
Value tees like Gildan Heavy Cotton and Port & Company Core Cotton keep big runs affordable. For crews, pocket tees and Carhartt workwear tees are popular upgrades.

**Can a bulk order have different sizes and colors?**
Yes. Mix sizes freely, including youth, tall and larger sizes where available. Different shirt colors work too, as long as the ink colors read well on each - we check that on the proof.

**Can you split a large order between locations?**
Yes. We can split-ship one order to multiple addresses, like your shop and individual job sites.

**How long does a bulk order take?**
About two weeks after you approve your proof. Rush production is available in as few as 3 business days.

### [Hi-vis safety apparel with your logo](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/hi-vis-safety-apparel)

Crews working near traffic, equipment and loading docks need to be seen. We decorate ANSI-rated hi-vis vests, hoodies and jackets from Carhartt and Port Authority, plus enhanced-visibility caps and bright safety-color tees, with your company logo - in the quantities a crew needs.

**What's the difference between ANSI Class 2 and Class 3?**
Both are high-visibility ratings under the ANSI/ISEA 107 standard. Class 3 garments carry more fluorescent and reflective material - including on the sleeves - for the highest visibility. Check your job site or employer requirements to see which class you need.

**Will printing or embroidering a logo affect the safety rating?**
We keep logos off the reflective striping and place them on the chest or another solid panel. If your safety program has specific rules for decoration, tell us on your quote and we'll plan around them.

**Can you add our logo to safety vests in bulk?**
Yes. Hi-vis vests, hoodies and jackets can be ordered in crew quantities with your logo, and we keep the file on hand for reorders.

**Do you have hi-vis caps?**
Yes. Port Authority enhanced-visibility caps in safety yellow and orange take embroidered logos.

## Work apparel for companies and trades

### [Work shirts & uniforms for crews that work for a living](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/work-apparel)

Meadow Prints & Embroidery outfits contractors, service companies and trades across Monmouth County with custom work tees, hi-vis safety apparel, Carhartt workwear, polos, jackets and hats. Big crew orders are what we do best - bulk pricing, your logo kept on file, and reorders as easy as a phone call.

**What's the minimum order for company shirts?**
Many products have no minimum. Screen-printed tees are most cost-effective at 12 pieces and up, and the price per shirt keeps dropping on larger crew orders.

**Do you keep our logo on file?**
Yes. We keep your artwork and embroidery file after your first order, so reorders for new hires are fast and match what the crew already wears.

**Can you embroider names on work shirts?**
Yes. We can stitch individual names on polos, work shirts and jackets. Send the name and size list when you approve your proof.

**Do you carry Carhartt and hi-vis safety apparel?**
Yes. We decorate Carhartt workwear and ANSI Class 2 and Class 3 hi-vis vests, hoodies and jackets, along with work tees and twill shirts from Port Authority, Port & Company and Gildan.

**Can you ship to our office or job site?**
Yes. We can ship to your shop, office or job site, and split an order between multiple addresses.

### [Landscaping & Lawn Care shirts & uniforms](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/work-apparel/landscaping)

Landscaping crews work in the sun, the rain and the mud from spring cleanups to snow season, and a matching shirt is how customers know your truck from the next one on the street. We print and embroider crew shirts, hi-vis tops, hoodies and hats for landscapers and lawn care companies all over Monmouth County.

**Do you give bulk pricing for landscaping & lawn care companies?**
Yes. Pricing drops as quantity goes up, and every quote includes free art setup. Screen printing gives the best value on runs of 12 shirts or more.

**How fast can you turn around a crew order?**
About two weeks after you approve your proof. Rush production is available in as few as 3 business days, and if you give us a hard deadline we will make sure it arrives on time.

**Can we mix sizes, styles and decoration in one order?**
Yes. Mix sizes freely, including tall and bigger sizes where available, and combine printed tees with embroidered polos, jackets and hats in one order.

**Do you have sun-protective shirts for summer crews?**
Yes. We carry UV-protective and moisture-wicking tees and long sleeves from Carhartt and Sport-Tek that take a printed or embroidered logo.

### [Construction & General Contractors shirts & uniforms](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/work-apparel/construction)

On a job site, a branded crew looks organized, is easy to spot and reflects well on the contractor. We outfit general contractors, builders and site crews with durable work tees, hi-vis safety apparel, hoodies, jackets and caps - printed or embroidered, in the quantities a crew actually needs.

**Do you give bulk pricing for construction & general contractors companies?**
Yes. Pricing drops as quantity goes up, and every quote includes free art setup. Screen printing gives the best value on runs of 12 shirts or more.

**How fast can you turn around a crew order?**
About two weeks after you approve your proof. Rush production is available in as few as 3 business days, and if you give us a hard deadline we will make sure it arrives on time.

**Can we mix sizes, styles and decoration in one order?**
Yes. Mix sizes freely, including tall and bigger sizes where available, and combine printed tees with embroidered polos, jackets and hats in one order.

**Can you put our logo on ANSI hi-vis safety apparel?**
Yes. We decorate ANSI Class 2 and Class 3 vests, hoodies and jackets and keep the logo off the reflective striping. If your site has specific rules, tell us on your quote and we will plan around them.

### [HVAC shirts & uniforms](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/work-apparel/hvac)

## Frequently asked questions

### [Questions? We've got answers.](https://www.meadowprintsandembroidery.com/faq)

Everything you need to know about ordering custom apparel with Meadow Prints. Still stuck? Reach a real human

**Where is Meadow Prints & Embroidery located?**
We are based in Monmouth County, New Jersey. We don't have a walk-in storefront - you order by phone, email or through this site, and we serve New Jersey, New York City and the tri-state area from our home base in Monmouth County.

**How do I contact you?**
Call (732) 763-6078, email meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com, or send a quote request. We're available Monday-Friday 8am-7pm and Saturday 10am-4pm.

**Can you embroider Nike, Carhartt and The North Face?**
Yes. We decorate name-brand apparel including Nike, Carhartt, The North Face, Port Authority, Sport-Tek, Gildan, Bella+Canvas and Comfort Colors. Browse them on our brands page.

**How do I send you my logo or design?**
Email it to meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com after you send your request. Any file works - we clean it up and get it ready for print or embroidery at no charge.

**Is there an order minimum?**
Many of our products have no minimum - order a single embroidered polo or a handful of tees. Screen printing is most cost-effective at 12+ pieces, but we'll always show you the best method for your quantity.

**How does pricing work?**
Your price depends on the garment, the number of ink colors or stitches, and quantity. The more you order, the lower your per-item price. Every quote includes free art setup - no hidden fees.

**Can I mix sizes and colors in one order?**
Absolutely. Mix adult and youth sizes freely. Mixing garment colors is fine too - as long as the print colors work on each, which we'll confirm on your proof.

**Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or bulk orders?**
Yes. Large orders automatically unlock volume pricing, and we offer special rates for schools, nonprofits, and fundraisers. Just mention it on your quote request.

**I'm not a designer - can you help?**
That's what we're here for. Just pick a product and send us a rough idea - sketch, screenshot, or a few words - and our team will create a mockup for you at no cost. You approve everything before we print.

**What file formats do you accept?**
PNG, JPG, PDF, AI, EPS, and SVG all work great. Vector files are ideal, but don't worry if you only have a logo image - we'll clean it up and vectorize it for free.

**Will I see a proof before printing?**
Always. You'll receive a digital proof - usually within 24 hours - showing exact colors, placement, and sizing. Nothing goes to production until you approve it.

**What's the difference between printing and embroidery?**
Printing applies ink to the fabric - great for bold, colorful, or detailed graphics. Embroidery stitches your design with thread for a raised, premium finish that's perfect for logos on polos, caps, and jackets.

**Is there a fee to digitize my logo?**
No - logo digitizing (converting your art into a stitch file) is free with your embroidery order. We keep the file on hand for fast, consistent reorders.

**How large can an embroidered design be?**
Left-chest logos are typically up to about 4 inches, while jacket backs can go much larger. We'll recommend the ideal size for your garment and design during proofing.

**How long does an order take?**
Standard production is about two weeks after you approve your proof, plus shipping. Need it sooner? Rush production can turn orders around in as few as 3 business days.

**Do you guarantee delivery dates?**
Yes. When you give us a hard deadline, we guarantee your order arrives on time - or we make it right. Just tell us your date on your quote.

**How much is shipping?**
Shipping is free on orders over $100. For smaller orders, we charge affordable flat-rate shipping shown before you check out. We can also split-ship to multiple addresses.

**What is the happiness guarantee?**
If your order isn't right - a misprint, a defect, or it doesn't match your approved proof - we'll reprint it or refund it. Your satisfaction is 100% guaranteed.

**Can I cancel or change my order?**
You can change or cancel anytime before you approve your proof at no charge. Once production begins we may not be able to make changes, so review your proof carefully.
